name: shared_multimorph_bc_anchored_retention_v1
initialization: Identical shared morphology-adapted BC actor in both arms, identical seeded critic and Adam. Same combined offline demo anchor in both arms. Std=.01, floor=-6; original .05-noise initialization was not robust.
constraints: No CPG reference, no controller handoff, no posture curriculum, native geometry/collisions/torque/velocity limits unchanged; only the shared command interface changes from v1.
budget_definition: Training transitions equal within each A/B seed pair. Evaluation interactions and offline BC updates are logged separately. No skipped morphology stages.
endpoint: Takeoff-phase goal is genuine push-off plus 35-degree supported airborne rotation. It is not a complete handstand.
final_evaluation_note: Fresh matched test resets, separate from development/authority/BC seeds. Saved separately from periodic development curves.
calibration_note: Frozen-actor calibration selected common latent std=.05 to retain front support while allowing exploration; learning rate=1e-5 and soft target KL=.01 use a conservative update scale for the narrower distribution. Earlier smoke/calibration outputs are preserved.
full_scale_reservation: Both arms receive the same extension, up to base + 262144 full-scale transitions + 8192 old-episode/rounding margin. No forced stage promotion.
